history.summary: THIS IS A CHRISTIAN CHURCH, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE. The Zarkawt Presbyterian Church stands on Mc Donald Hill in the Zarkawt locality of Aizawl, near the High School Field and the Mizoram State Museum, as a local congregation of the Mizoram Presbyterian Church Synod, Mizoram's largest Christian denomination (about 6,28,719 members in 2023), a constituent body of the Presbyterian Church of India with its headquarters at Mission Veng, Aizawl. The Synod traces its origin to 11 January 1894, when the Rev. J.H. Lorrain and Rev. F.W. Savidge arrived in the Lushai Hills (sent by the Arthington Aborigines Mission); the Welsh Calvinistic Methodist (later Presbyterian Church of Wales) mission, under Rev. D.E. Jones from 1897, took over the Aizawl field and organized the first congregation (Mission Veng, 1898). The Synod as an organized administrative body dates to the early 20th century (1924 per the dataset brief - verify). Zarkawt is one of the older church localities of Aizawl, but the church's exact founding year and building history were not found in published English-language sources (verify).

name: Zarkawt Presbyterian Church
town_description: Aizawl is the capital and largest city of Mizoram, set on a ridge at about 1,132 m with the Tlawng river valley to its west and the Tuirial valley to its east. It is a predominantly Christian city where Christmas (Krismas) is the biggest festival, and churches are the centres of community life. Zarkawt is a central locality of Aizawl near the Mizoram State Museum and the High School Field; the church sits on Mc Donald Hill (PIN 796007). Visitors to Mizoram need an Inner Line Permit (ILP).

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (AJL), about 22 km from Aizawl; taxis and app cabs to Zarkawt.
travel.railway: Sairang Railway Station, about 17 km from Aizawl, on the new Bairabi-Sairang line (inaugurated September 2025); Bairabi station about 100 km (verify).
travel.road: Central Aizawl; Mc Donald Hill, Zarkawt, is easily reached by city bus, shared taxi or auto from the city centre (Dawrpui area) within a few minutes.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for cool, clear weather. Christmas and New Year are the most festive but crowded; Mizoram requires an Inner Line Permit for visitors from other Indian states.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Sunday services (typically Sunday morning worship and Sunday school, with evening services; typical Aizawl Presbyterian pattern - verify, not published). Visitors are welcome at services but should dress modestly.
